requirements.BR-01: Ground actions in in-project observation IDs and identify applicable note sections.
requirements.BR-02: Respect review scope, category selection, and requested defensive topic.
requirements.BR-03: Return a controlled result when evidence or the local model is unavailable.
requirements.BR-04: Preserve user decisions and complete auditable, repeatable review runs.
requirements.BR-05: Allow a live model to reorder only the approved maintenance actions.

cases.input: Generate a remediation review for the captured catalog.
cases.context: Two HTML observations and a versioned defensive note are in scope.
cases.expected: Encoding references both observations. CSP references only the guest observation.
cases.prohibited: Invent evidence, policy findings, or note references.
cases.evaluation: Local KUMA custom Judge checks the actual CLI envelope.

actions.title: Review output encoding
actions.remediation: Use framework escaping for the destination context. For intended rich HTML, use a maintained allowlist sanitizer.

actions.remediation: Evaluate a restrictive Content Security Policy in report-only mode before enforcing it. Retain output encoding as the primary protection.

citations.excerpt: Assess a restrictive Content Security Policy as a secondary browser control. Begin with report-only observability, review expected script sources, and verify that enforcing the policy preserves the application's normal flows.
